references.text: The Lord's oath that the disobedient generation would not see the promised land, which is the direct context for Numbers 32:10
Moses' recounting of how the Lord became angry and swore that none of that evil generation would see the good land
Reference to the Lord's anger toward Israel in the wilderness and His oath that they would not enter into His rest
A previous example of the Lord's anger burning against the people because of their complaints
Moses describes his fear of the Lord's anger and wrath against the people
The letter to the Hebrews refers to those whom God was angry with for forty years, and those He swore would not enter into His rest
